meta_title: Infographic Prompts for GPT Image 2 — Data Viz with Real Text
meta_description: Copy-paste infographic prompts for GPT Image 2. Process diagrams, isometric breakdowns, data viz, educational. Pixel-level text rendering for legible labels and stats.
intro_long: 13 tested GPT Image 2 prompts that produce labeled infographics with pixel-perfect text — process diagrams, isometric breakdowns, and data visualizations.

how_it_works.title: Pick an infographic format
how_it_works.body: Choose process diagram, isometric exploded view, data viz, comparison, or timeline based on your topic.

how_it_works.title: Quote labels and data points
how_it_works.body: Wrap exact strings in `label: "EXACT TEXT"` JSON syntax — keeps labels accurate and prevents garbled output.

how_it_works.title: Generate at 2K or 4K resolution
how_it_works.body: High resolution is required for legible small text. 2K minimum for charts; 4K for dense isometric callouts.

why_use.title: Pixel-level text rendering
why_use.body: Labels, stats, axis names, and callouts all render legibly — no garbled letters that plague Midjourney or SDXL infographic outputs.

why_use.title: JSON template locks layout
why_use.body: Structured prompts pin down label position, hierarchy, and color coding — exploded callouts land where you specify, not randomly.

why_use.title: Reasoning model plans composition
why_use.body: GPT Image 2 thinks through layout, label spacing, and visual hierarchy before drawing — fewer overlapping labels and unbalanced charts.

tips.a: Yes — it is one of the few models with reliable text rendering for infographics. Use the JSON template pattern (`label: "EXACT TEXT"`) and generate at 2K or 4K. Process diagrams, isometric breakdowns, and data viz all work; keep total labels to 8-10 max per image.

tips.q: How do I prompt AI to make readable labels?
tips.a: Quote every label exactly with `label: "EXACT TEXT"` JSON syntax, specify font weight (bold sans-serif), and request 2K minimum resolution. Cap at 8-10 labels per image — packing more text causes garbled output even with GPT Image 2.

tips.q: What should an infographic prompt include?
tips.a: Five required parts: (1) format type (process / isometric / data viz), (2) layout aspect ratio (9:16 or 16:9), (3) exact label strings in quoted JSON fields, (4) color scheme with semantic mapping, (5) resolution at 2K+ with sharp text rendering as an explicit instruction.

tips.q: How do I avoid wrong text in AI diagrams?
tips.a: Three fixes: (1) wrap every label in `label: "EXACT TEXT"` JSON syntax instead of inline prose, (2) limit to 8-10 labels per image, (3) set bold sans-serif font weight and request 2K+ resolution. Re-roll once if a label still misspells — GPT Image 2 lands it the second pass.

faq.q: Can GPT Image 2 generate infographics with readable text?
faq.a: Yes — pixel-level text rendering is its key advantage over Midjourney/SDXL. Numbers, labels, callouts, and headings all render legibly. Wrap exact text in double quotes in your prompt. For complex infographics keep total text under 400 words to avoid garbled output.

faq.q: What's the best AI prompt for infographics?
faq.a: Reliable template: '[Type] infographic explaining [topic]. Layout: [vertical 9:16 / horizontal 16:9]. Style: [flat / isometric / hand-drawn]. Include: [3-5 key data points or steps]. Bold sans-serif typography. Color-coded sections. Clean white background.' Specify type (process / data viz / comparison) for accuracy.

faq.q: How to make isometric infographics with AI?
faq.a: Use this template: 'Isometric 3D infographic of [object/system], 45-degree perspective, exploded view showing internal components, color-coded callout labels, technical pen line art, white background, museum-exhibit aesthetic.' This is the viral GitHub dataset format used by tech educators.

Vertical 9:16 (1080×1920) for Pinterest / Instagram / mobile reading. Horizontal 16:9 (1920×1080) for presentations / LinkedIn carousel. Square 1:1 (1080×1080) for Instagram feed. Specify in your prompt and at 2K resolution for crisp text.

faq.q: GPT Image 2 vs Venngage / Piktochart — which is better for infographics?
faq.a: Venngage / Piktochart are template-based (drag and drop). GPT Image 2 is prompt-based (full creative control + custom illustrations). Use template tools when you need quick standard layouts. Use GPT Image 2 when you need (1) custom illustrations matching your brand, (2) isometric / 3D / artistic styles, (3) text + visual hybrid that templates can't do.

json_template._note: 复杂 infographic 推荐 JSON 结构化 prompt（参考 awesome-gpt-image-2 VR Headset 模式）。{argument name="X" default="Y"} 是动态参数语法，工作台会解析为可填表单。

template.subject: {argument name="subject" default="product or concept"}
template.style: clean technical illustration, color-coded callouts, white background, museum exhibit aesthetic

layout.centerpiece: {argument name="centerpiece_description" default="central isometric/exploded view showing N components"}

template.color_scheme: {argument name="color_scheme" default="RED for power/battery, BLUE for data, ORANGE for thermal, GREEN for sensors"}
